reasons.plausibility: Forming a protective oxide scale is a known way to reduce oxidation damage, but it may not fully address the core challenge of improved high-temperature mechanical strength, so it is plausible but incomplete.
reasons.testability: It can be tested by comparing oxidation rates and mechanical properties for the modified and baseline alloys under high-temperature conditions, but the proposed test lacks detail on the mechanical performance criteria.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a partial route to slow oxidation, yet does not clearly solve the strength loss challenge; thus it may help but only partly addresses the original application.
